payload.folded: SP1 confirmed U1 (run-2e1841091b74): qrcode-generator (npm-fetchable, MIT, zero runtime deps) encodes an ntfy topic into a VALID QR matrix - 29x29 modules, 449 dark, finder pattern present at the corners. So ADR-1 (vendor) stands and is EXECUTABLE - K2 is feasible, K1 hand-roll is not needed. QS-1 scannability moves from at-risk toward addressed (the vendored encoder yields a correct matrix; the M7 known-answer test locks it). No requirement or ADR invalidated - the design stands. Correction to the earlier worry: npm IS reachable here, so vendoring a library IS possible (I only need to COPY its source, not depend on npm at runtime).
